title: Triple-Action Therapy: Combining Machine Learning, Docking, and Dynamics to Combat BRCA1-Mutated Breast Cancer.
authors: Zainulabidin, Ashiru Aliyu; Sufyan, Aminu Jibril; Thirunavukkarasu, Muthu Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该研究用机器学习、分子对接和动力学模拟筛选BRCA1蛋白的小分子抑制剂，对象是蛋白-配体互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题关联微弱。
abstract: Breast cancer dominates women's mortality, and among other factors, mutations in the BRCA1 gene are significant risk factors. Several approaches are followed to treat the BRCA1 affected cancer patients. However, specific BRCA1 inhibitors are not available till date due to its structural complexity. In addition, there are several limitations associated with the existing drugs used to treat BRCA1-related breast cancer and some side effects. The side effects include symptoms such as hot flashes, joint pain, nausea, fatigue, hair loss, diarrhea, chills, fever, and others. Therefore, advanced approaches needed that can overcome all the limitations and side effects of the current inhibitors. In this study, we adopted a multistep approach to identify potential inhibitors for BRCA1-mutated breast cancer. We used our developed machine learning models to screen potential inhibitors. Molecular docking approach was carried out for the screened hit compounds with BRCA1 and its mutated forms. Two ligands, beta-amyrin and Narirutin, has shown significant performance in multiple scoring schemes such as molecular docking and RF score calculations. Molecular dynamics simulations demonstrated the stability of the complexes formed by beta-amyrin and Narirutin with BRCA1, with lower RMSD values and less RMSF fluctuations at the binding site locations. Principal component analysis (PCA) and free energy landscape (FEL) further confirmed the compactness and favorable binding of beta-Amyrin and Narirutin to BRCA1. These findings suggest that beta-amyrin and Narirutin have potential as therapeutic agents against BRCA1-mutated breast cancer.
abstract_zh: 乳腺癌是女性死亡的主要原因，其中BRCA1基因突变是重要的风险因素之一。目前已有多种方法用于治疗受BRCA1影响的癌症患者。然而，由于BRCA1结构的复杂性，至今尚无特定的BRCA1抑制剂。此外，现有用于治疗BRCA1相关乳腺癌的药物存在多种局限性及副作用，包括潮热、关节疼痛、恶心、疲劳、脱发、腹泻、寒战、发热等症状。因此，需要先进的方法来克服当前抑制剂的局限性和副作用。在本研究中，我们采用多步骤方法识别针对BRCA1突变乳腺癌的潜在抑制剂。我们利用开发的机器学习模型筛选潜在抑制剂，并对筛选出的命中化合物与BRCA1及其突变形式进行分子对接 (molecular docking) 分析。两种配体，β-香树脂醇 (beta-amyrin) 和柚皮苷 (Narirutin)，在多种评分方案（如分子对接和RF评分计算）中表现出显著性能。分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟显示，β-香树脂醇和柚皮苷与BRCA1形成的复合物具有稳定性，结合位点处的RMSD值较低，RMSF波动较小。主成分分析 (PCA) 和自由能景观 (FEL) 进一步证实了β-香树脂醇和柚皮苷与BRCA1结合的紧凑性和有利性。这些发现表明，β-香树脂醇和柚皮苷具有作为BRCA1突变乳腺癌治疗药物的潜力。
